items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee's name is J.C. Higginbotham. The transcript contains only the interviewer mentioning 'Henry Brooks' as part of a band lineup. The interviewee does not speak or respond in the provided context.

ctx.x: That would be 5. Was there more than that?
There was two brothers that was playing. (Albert) Brooks and Henry Brooks.
